sources.snippet: ColModernVBert is a model for efficient visual document retrieval. It leverages ModernVBert to construct multi-vector embeddings directly from document images, following the ColPali approach. The model was introduced in ModernVBERT: Towards Smaller Visual Document Retrievers.
